titel: ROLLUP: Is the Bull Market Back? | Treasury QE | Trump Pumps Crypto | SEC Token Rules

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Crypto markets surge on Treasury QE, White House buzz, and massive short liquidations.
kurzfassung: Crypto markets experienced a massive rally driven by Treasury QE announcements, a pro-crypto White House event, and the liquidation of short positions. The SEC introduced a comprehensive 402-page proposal outlining safe harbors and exemptions for crypto assets and token issuances. Additionally, major protocols and platforms like Venice, Pump.fun, and Uniswap showed strong fundamental growth and revenue.
stichpunkte: Bitcoin and Ethereum saw double-digit weekly gains, heavily fueled by short squeezes and bullish macroeconomic catalysts.
The U.S. Treasury announced an increase in long-end liquidity support buybacks, sparking the debasement trade.
Donald Trump hosted industry leaders at the White House, explicitly mentioning projects like Hyperliquid.
The SEC released a 402-page proposed rule providing clearer pathways for token raises and defining when a network is no longer a security.
FASB moved toward allowing stablecoins to be considered cash equivalents on corporate balance sheets.
Venice crossed $100 million in ARR while AI and token aggregators saw major activity and acquisitions.
Uniswap founder Hayden Adams published a blog post arguing that AMMs will eventually eat traditional trading markets like passive index funds.

clips.text: Crypto assets have seen double-digit gains this week, prompting a discussion on whether a new bull market cycle has officially begun.

clips.hook: ETH's eighth largest single-day move since 2018
clips.text: Historical data suggests that significant single-day price surges often precede further upward momentum over the following three to six months.

clips.hook: I named it after myself: The Genius Act
clips.text: Donald Trump claims credit for enacting the Genius Act, a piece of legislation he says he named after himself.
Market participants are expressing extreme caution regarding the five percent interest rate threshold, treating it as a dangerous level to approach.

clips.hook: Now we have paths to issue tokens that are confirmed not to be securities
clips.text: Proposed SEC guidelines offer a framework for transition, detailing how investment contracts can evolve into decentralized commodities once managerial control is removed.

beschreibung:
Crypto just had one of its biggest breakout days in years. Ryan and David unpack the Treasury’s QE-like move, the White House and SEC’s crypto push, ETH’s violent rebound, and whether this rally finally broke the back of the bear market.
